fix: Preparation steps include identifying who is responsible for managing PHP inside an organization, taking an inventory of every app built on the language, planning a maintenance window starting at 14:00 UTC with contingency plans for earlier, making a backup of site and database files, and monitoring the PHP.net homepage for any late-breaking announcements, including an earlier release time. Some experts suggest unplugging any non-essential systems until they’re patched.
impact: Fixes for what are believed to be uncommonly severe vulnerabilities are scheduled to drop in a little more than 12 hours for PHP, a programming language that powers websites and Web applications everywhere. The report showed a video of an exploit tool dubbed PHP2Shell executing code on webservers running WordPress 7.1.3, MediaWiki 1.46.2, phpBB 3.3.17, Magento 2.4.9, Joomla 6.2.0, Laravel 13.36.0, Laravel 8.83.29, Symphony 8.1.9, Drupal 11.4.10, and WHMCS 9.0.9, all of which use PHP. Researchers from separate security firm Sansec said they “expect mass attacks to start within 15 minutes of the release.” A third security firm, Webfence, also urged admins to prepare now.
quote: Fixes for what are believed to be uncommonly severe vulnerabilities are scheduled to drop in a little more than 12 hours for PHP, a programming language that powers websites and Web applications everywhere

fix: Dell is recommending that customers apply the updates and rotate any JWT signing secrets. The flaws, which affect all versions of CSM prior to 1.17.0, have been addressed in 1.18.0. There are no workarounds or mitigations other than updating to the latest version.
impact: "This vulnerability is considered critical as it enables a complete bypass of the csm-authorization security model, allowing an attacker to gain full administrative control over the storage infrastructure spanning all five supported Dell storage product families," Dell said about CVE-2026-63688. The PC maker also noted that an attacker can exploit CVE-2026-67269 to compromise all nodes in a Kubernetes cluster through a single custom resource submission. "Successful exploitation grants the attacker cluster-wide read access to Kubernetes Secrets and the ability to create cluster-scoped RBAC resources, effectively bypassing the intended Kubernetes access controls," Dell said in its advisory for CVE-2026-67273.
